summary.text: Cyndi Carrasco is a Republican member of the Indiana Senate for District 36, elected in 2023.
The caucus page lists Carrasco as chair of the Judiciary Committee and ranking member of the Corrections and Criminal Law Committee.

paragraphs.text: Carrasco studied political science at the University of Texas at El Paso and attended the Indiana University McKinney School of Law, according to the page.
It lists Carrasco as a member of the Indiana State Bar Association since 2021 and as a trustee of Saint Mary-of-the-Woods College from 2017 to 2023.
Carrasco represents portions of Johnson and Marion counties, and the page also lists membership on the Environmental Affairs and Insurance and Financial Institutions committees.
